notes.title: Version 1.1.0 is live! Happy Half-Anniversary!
notes.content:
Hello again! Not long ago was Recursion Deluxe's Half-Anniversary! It has been just over 6 months since we launched the game on Steam, so we thought it was high time that we push an update out to you guys.

[h1]Weeklong Sale - 50% Off![/h1]
To celebrate this update, we'll be offering a 50% discount beginning August 22nd at 10:00am PST lasting for 7 days. If you don't have the game, [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/425160]pick it up while it's cheap[/url]!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11808131/1a86e21542fecc53bc45e0c31f944a602b09343c.png[/img]

[h1]Here are the notable changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added 20 Steam Achievements
[*] Added 2 new Secret Statues to find
[*] Added 7 Secret Challenge Levels
[*] Added More Levels button to Main Menu
[*] Added new options to the Settings menu
	[list]
	[*] Joystick - enable/disable analog sticks (for those of you with driver issues)
	[*] Resolution - increase/decrease game resolution
	[*] Filter - a few graphical shaders to play with
	[/list]
[*] Added an external Level Editor*
[*] Separated Main Menu from Title Screen
[*] Rebalanced many of the levels based on player feedback
[*] Improved memory handling (still leaks a bit - we're working on it!)
[*] Various minor bugfixes and tweaks
[/list]

*Note - You can access the Level Editor from the More Levels screen. The Level Editor is still considered to be in 'beta' so you may run into a few hiccups. Sorry in advance!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11808131/7be9a1059e5cc789284ff1410fc4fb49bd38ac8d.png[/img]

Please report any and all issues you have on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/425160/discussions/]Steam Forums[/url] so that we may fix them as quickly as possible! We also encourage you to share any interesting levels you create on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/425160]Community Hub[/url] so that others can try them (we'll be rolling out a level browser in the next update).

With this update, we've improved our content pipeline so that it should be a lot easier to get new content out more frequently. Thank you for your patience, and [b]please enjoy the update[/b]!
